title: Modular learning plan for the Skyview Hotel Document Knowledge Assistant
reason: User requested one LangChain feature per module, separate explanatory lessons, and an entry point limited to initialization and dispatch.
scope: Project 1 features and supporting modules, introduced incrementally. The original 60-topic syllabus remains the overarching map across three projects. Conceptual pages and alternative frontend libraries do not each require a Python module.
module_boundary_rule: Feature code belongs to its named module. Helpers may call one another, but dependency direction and each feature must remain easy to locate. Not every module is a LangChain feature; distinguish source loading, configuration, storage and orchestration as application code.

bootstrap_contract.package_initializer: __init__.py stays minimal; importing the package does not start the application.
bootstrap_contract.main: main.py initializes settings and invokes app.run_app; it does not read PDFs, split text, write chunks, query models or implement retrieval.
bootstrap_contract.migration_note: Change the console-script target only after the new main function and the modules it imports exist. Do not empty the current initializer before preserving its useful code in the feature module.

initial_data_contracts.meaning: Return one PDF source text plus filename/version metadata. No model request.
Return chunk Documents using RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter, preserving source metadata.
Write JSON with stable chunk identifiers, page_content and metadata.
Coordinate the loader, splitter and local persistence without moving their implementations into main.

citation_design: Combining all PDF pages initially retains the filename but not automatically accurate page citations. Preserve page/section mappings in a dedicated loader enhancement before claiming precise page citations; never label every chunk page 1.

modules.responsibility: Keep minimal; package identity only, with no ingestion, model calls, file writes or application startup on import.
Load settings and hand control to the application coordinator; no feature implementation.
Read environment/configuration, source locations and local output paths; avoid hardcoded secrets.
Choose and invoke the current ingestion or question-answering workflow; keep the startup module small.
Read an approved source PDF and return its extracted text with source metadata. Start with one Document per source PDF, rather than a separate lesson creating page Documents.
Configure RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter and produce chunk Documents. No file reading or persistence here.
Serialize chunk text and metadata to JSON and reconstruct Documents when loading. No database in the initial implementation.
Compose source loading, text splitting and local saving. This is workflow glue rather than an extra LangChain feature.
Initialize and configure the OpenAI chat-model integration.
Construct and inspect system, user, AI and tool messages.
Create the embedding component used to represent chunk/query meaning. Add only when semantic retrieval is introduced.
Select relevant saved chunks for a question; keep access/version filters and evidence selection separate from model generation. Storage may remain local.
Define typed search tools that delegate to retrieval; tools must not absorb all loader/storage implementation.
Compose model, tools, instructions and feature configurations with create_agent.
Define validated answer/citation schemas and the response-format integration.
Configure conversation-state persistence and thread identity. Start locally; defer Postgres.
Configure approved user preferences/memory and namespaces; keep this distinct from document retrieval.
Consume typed message/tool/state projections using the documented event-streaming API.
Isolate the separate stream/astream API lesson and compare it with event streaming.
Compose prebuilt and custom middleware while keeping hooks and their purposes visible.
Keep evidence validation, tool authorization boundaries and relevant deterministic checks visible as a distinct lesson.
Define and inject trusted per-request context and dependencies.
Select history, retrieved evidence, prompts and available tools without hiding those choices in the entry point.
Configure tracing and useful redacted metadata; no credentials in source.
Run the held-out hotel question set and inspect grounded answers, citations and retrieval quality.

first_lessons.goal: Create a source-loading module and move the PDF-reading responsibility there; explain module import, function parameter and returned Document.
Create the LangChain splitting feature; explain its input, configuration and returned chunk list.
Save/reload chunks as inspectable local JSON; preserve citations and versions.
Connect the three existing feature functions into one ingestion workflow.
Create the startup/dispatch code, update the console-script mapping and leave package initialization minimal.
Introduce retrieval and answer generation in separate documented lessons; decide a local retrieval index when that lesson begins.
Introduce each agent/memory/streaming/testing feature in its own module when the curriculum reaches it.

teaching_workflow: The user types application code and commands.
Explain purpose, relevant general Python concepts, data input/output, and LangChain documentation before each implementation.
Create a module when its lesson starts; empty placeholders may be added only if the user requests scaffolding.
Inspect saved code/output without changing it; do not treat a proposed refactor as completed.
later_extensions: Place MCP, human review, multi-agent patterns and frontend components in their own feature modules or UI components when the respective original syllabus lessons are reached. Do not invent a universal industry-mandated folder layout.
